newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Wesfarmers plans A$30 million plant.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Wesfarmers plans A$30 million plant.

text.p: Wesfarmers Ltd said on Tuesday that its Australian Gold Reagents Pty Ltd (AGR) joint venture planned to build a A$30 million sodium cyanide production plant at Kwinana, south of Perth.
The company said the plant would meet the growing demand from the gold mining industry in the state of Western Australia.
Sodium cyanide is an essential reagent used by mines in the gold extraction process.
The plant would be the second manufacturing facility at the Kwinana site and raise total production to about 70,000 tonnes a year. AGR is the only sodium cyanide maker in the state.
It is 60 percent owned by Wesfarmers CSBP Ltd, 20 percent by privately-held Coogee Chemicals Pty Ltd, and 20 percent by the Australian government-owned investment bank AIDC Ltd.
Wesfarmers said about 30,000 tonnes of sodium cyanide is imported each year from overseas or eastern Australia in pellet form and dissolved at the mine site.
